cues: Questions: convert first, then put the sentence back into question form.
Did he write the letter: was the letter written by him?
Who broke the window: by whom was the window broken?
And prepositional verbs keep their preposition, even though its object has moved to the front.
They laughed at him: he was laughed at.
Someone must look after the baby: the baby must be looked after.
They sent for the doctor: the doctor was sent for.
